scenes.headline: How Soofi S keeps its cache nearly constant
scenes.sub: A German-English hybrid Mamba-Transformer mixture of experts, 3B active.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Photon! Soofi S is an open German and English model from a German consortium. Here's why its decode speed barely changes as the context grows.

scenes.text: Keep attention in only 6 of 52 layers. Mamba-2 carries the rest with a fixed-size state, so the cache barely grows with context.
scenes.say: The idea: keep attention in only six of fifty-two layers. Mamba-2 carries the rest with a fixed-size state, so the cache barely grows.

steps.say: Soofi S reuses Nemotron 3 Nano's design unchanged: fifty-two layers, mostly Mamba-2 and mixture of experts.
Twenty-three Mamba-2 layers do most of the sequence mixing, each with a fixed-size recurrent state.
Only six attention layers keep a cache that grows, with two KV heads each: about six kilobytes per token.
Capacity lives in the experts: six of a hundred twenty-eight per token, plus two shared. About three point two billion parameters active.

scenes.title: Pretraining, German on purpose
scenes.say: Then the data: about twenty-seven trillion tokens, in three phases.

items.say: Twenty trillion diverse tokens, with German up-weighted to seven point two percent.
Six point five eight trillion of annealing, with German at fifteen point three two percent.
Then a short extension pushes the window to a million tokens.

scenes.title: Gain over Nemotron 3 Nano, same backbone
scenes.say: Because the backbone matches Nemotron 3 Nano exactly, the data's effect can be measured: German proficiency up fifteen point one points, held-out English up six point seven.

scenes.text: Keep the growing cache in six layers and a fixed state everywhere else, and decode speed stops caring about context length.
scenes.say: So keep the growing cache in six layers and a fixed state everywhere else, and decode speed stops caring how long the context is.

recap: Only 6 of 52 layers keep a KV cache
German up-weighted; same architecture as Nemotron 3 Nano
scenes.say: To recap: six caches in fifty-two layers, a small active slice of a large model, and German on purpose.
